entities.name: José Pedro de Morais
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Pedro de Morais is an Angolan politician, who served as Minister of Finance from December 2002 to October 2008, replacing Júlio Marcelino Vieira Bessa. In January 2015, he was appointed Governor of the National Bank of Angola.

entities.name: José Pedro de Morais
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José Pedro de Morais is an Angolan politician, who served as Minister of Finance from December 2002 to October 2008, replacing Júlio Marcelino Vieira Bessa. In January 2015, he was appointed Governor of the National Bank of Angola.
